t: Pocket-sized torch that features 6x adjustable zoom and dual-direction clip to attach to clothing or gear. Durable aluminium body and water-resistant for outdoor use. Powerful magnetic base for convenient hands-free lighting with on/off button for easy operation. 4 light modes; high (250lm), low (80lm), strobe (250lm) and turbo mode, offering short bursts of 450lm when required, returning to previous mode after 40 seconds. Flex-Fuel technology allows the light to be powered by a single AA battery or rechargeable battery (included).
